ground_truth_ambiguous_case_analysis.explanation: All 100 ground-truth AMBIGUOUS cases had reference matches with amounts that differed, causing the reference match + amount difference stage (Stage 3) to deterministically classify them as AMOUNT_MISMATCH before reaching the fuzzy candidate ambiguity stage (Stage 4/5).

ground_truth_duplicate_case_analysis.explanation: In the ground-truth benchmark, each DUPLICATE case references the primary bank transaction ID (e.g. SYNTH-BANK-000009), which the Day 1 engine successfully resolved as MATCH with the ledger, while the duplicate bank record (SYNTH-BANK-DUP-000009) was correctly emitted as DUPLICATE in the source-level output. In single-transaction case mapping, the primary transaction is evaluated.
